name: Newcastle University Medicine Malaysia

programmes.name: Medicine (MBBS)
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery
programmes.about: A five-year Newcastle MBBS taught in Malaysia, with case-based teaching, early patient contact and hospital placements across Johor.
programmes.overview: Years 1 and 2 use case-based learning and early clinical experience, with anatomy, simulation and clinical reasoning. Years 3 to 5 are clinical placements in Johor hospitals and community clinics, an eight-week student-selected component in Year 4 and an eight-week elective in Year 5. Assessment is equivalent to Newcastle UK. Optional routes include a Year 2 semester in Newcastle or an intercalated year.
programmes.ib: Minimum 33 points (including TOK/EE points) with HL Biology, Chemistry and Mathematics, each at 5 or above.
programmes.selectionNote: Applicants are interviewed from January for the September entry; UCAT is not required. Malaysian Medical Council subject rules also apply.

flagshipSource.title: NUMed Malaysia MBBS: five years in Malaysia, GMC and MMC recognised

programmes.name: Data Science
programmes.about: A three-year Newcastle BSc delivered entirely in Malaysia, with an industrial placement and a final-year health and biomedical data science focus.
programmes.overview: Stage 1 builds programming, mathematics and statistics. Stage 2 covers inference, algorithms and numerical methods and includes an industrial placement. Stage 3 specialises in health and biomedical data science, statistical modelling, machine learning and computer vision, and ends with a supervised applied project.
programmes.ib: 30 points, with at least one science subject at HL grade 5 or above; SL Maths at 4 or above if not taken at HL.
programmes.selectionNote: Grade-based entry. Applicants without a pre-university qualification complete one first.

notes: Closing date: 16 July 2027 applies to international applicants. Malaysian applicants have no formal closing date, though places are limited. Enrolment registration is 20 September 2027; MBBS is listed for a September 2027 start.

Biomedical Sciences and Sport and Exercise Science are not listed as programmes: both spend Stages 1 and 2 in Malaysia and Stage 3 at Newcastle in the UK, which needs a UK visa. The Foundation in Science is a pathway, not a degree.

MBBS recognition: the programme page states recognition by the General Medical Council and the Malaysian Medical Council, among others. Applicants must also meet MMC subject rules, such as Biology, Chemistry and Physics or Mathematics at pre-university level.
MBBS English: IELTS 7.0 overall (page footnote adds 6.5 in each element), or TOEFL iBT 100 or PTE Academic 69. Data Science: IELTS 6.5 overall.

Fees for 2027/28 entry: MBBS RM 142,252 and other undergraduate degrees RM 59,572 for international students, including 6% SST, charged per academic year. Deposits on accepting an offer are RM 20,000 (MBBS) and RM 5,000 (BSc).
Medicine requires a personal statement, a school reference, transcripts or forecast results, an interview and health and age (18+) checks.
Data Science IB entry reads 'at least one science subject at HL grade 5'; the page does not say which sciences count.
